input.body:
label: bug
file: src/export/scheduler.ts

Weekly and monthly schedules add 7 days or 1 month to `next` without checking whether `next <= from`, so a schedule created on a Monday before 06:00 UTC misses the run later that same day.

input.title: Fix weekly scheduled export never sending the first week
input.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the weekly case unconditionally advances the date by 7 days from `next` (which has been set to run hour on the `from` date). If a weekly schedule is created before the run hour on its starting day, `next` is already on or after `from` for that day, but the weekly case still jumps ahead 7 days instead of checking whether it is due today (like `daily` does). Update the weekly case to check if `next > from`, and only advance by 7 days if it is not.
